title: Woman Tells Cop to Hurry Up Before He Discovers Her Warrant
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On November 26, 2022, an officer initiated a traffic stop on a speeding vehicle in La Crosse, WI. As the female driver became impatient with the officer, dispatch advised the operator of the vehicle had a misdemeanor warrant. She was soon ordered to exit the vehicle but decided to flee at a high rate of speed, causing damage to parked vehicles. She was later located at her residence and taken into custody. 

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
